- Section 41 of CrPC
- Section 50 of CrPC
- Section 57 of CrPC

  Authority: Police

  Authority: Magistrate
  Time limit: 24 hours

  Under D.K. Basu guidelines, you must be medically examined every 48 hours during detention.
